skips.detail: Thoughts and Draft stream separately, but the active turn does not expose the required Writing response status label.
Streamed shell output is not exposed through the required Classic Output status pane semantics.
A simulated terminal provider outage does not settle into one visible agent error within the compliance timeout.
The collapsed thought panel does not expose the required newest-nine-line disclosure window.
Escape does not collapse an expanded thought panel back to the required tail disclosure window.
Deleting a visible assistant reply does not remove that reply from the timeline and persisted reload state.
Cascade confirmation counts two replies where the deterministic fixture has one visible reply.
Saving Plan Markdown updates the sidebar UI but the session-scoped plan tool returns “Tool plan not found”.
A remote Plan write cannot be applied because the session-scoped plan tool returns “Tool plan not found”.
The Plan sidebar exists, but the model cannot access the required session-scoped plan tool.
Quick Actions opens, but its search control is exposed as “Search quick actions” rather than the required slash-command textbox contract.
Quick Actions has no loaded skill commands and exposes its search control outside the required slash-command textbox contract.
Saving Plan Markdown updates the sidebar UI but the session-scoped plan tool returns “Tool plan not found”.
A remote Plan write cannot be applied because the session-scoped plan tool returns “Tool plan not found”.
Plan checklist UI exists, but the model cannot access the required session-scoped plan tool.
User-authored hostile fenced SVG is rendered as a data-image preview instead of remaining inert source.
The manifest declares 192x192 and 512x512 static icons, but both served files are 256x256.
The required sized Apple touch icon routes return non-success responses.
The favicon route returns a non-success response instead of a compatible non-empty image.
Steering removes the queued item, but the interrupted original turn never produces its expected persisted reply.
A failed Steer does not expose the required warning that the item could not be sent as steering.
While a submission request is pending, the composer is disabled and cannot accept the newer draft required for failed-send restoration.
Returning a queued message removes the queue item but leaves the newer editor draft instead of replacing it with the queued text.
During a held attachment upload, the upload action remains enabled instead of exposing disabled upload-progress state.
The session picker does not expose the required accessible session-search control while an upload is pending.
After a synthetic Replies-exist rejection and confirmed retry, the expected persisted parent message is absent after reload.
This runtime profile does not claim @cap-agent-avatar and supplies no composer command for setting an agent avatar.
This runtime profile does not claim @cap-agent-avatar and supplies no composer command for clearing an agent avatar.
The deterministic idle-chat reply intermittently fails to appear in WebKit phone while passing the other five projects and prior isolated runs.
